title: Enterprise Attack Graph Analysis and Incident Response Pipeline

pipeline.objective: Construct the 12-node enterprise network graph in python_repl (using networkx: 'import networkx as nx; G = nx.DiGraph()' or a dict). Store the graph in REPL as 'G'. Ensure all 12 nodes across DMZ (4), INTERNAL (4), and SECURE_CORE (4) zones are present.

verification_criteria.assertion: len(G.nodes if hasattr(G, 'nodes') else (G.get('nodes') if isinstance(G, dict) and 'nodes' in G else G)) == 12

pipeline.objective: Using python_repl and the existing 12-node graph 'G' from Step 1, compute the shortest path from 'DMZ_WEB_01' to 'CORE_DB_01'. Do NOT redefine or shrink 'G'. Store only the traversal dictionary in REPL as 'attack_analysis' containing 'shortest_path', 'hops', 'blast_radius', and 'choke_point'.
Deterministically materialize 'incident_graph_data.json' from REPL graph 'G' and 'attack_analysis'.

template.nodes: $eval:list(G.nodes(data=True)) if hasattr(G, 'nodes') else (G.get('nodes', G) if isinstance(G, dict) else G)
template.edges: $eval:list(G.edges(data=True)) if hasattr(G, 'edges') else (G.get('edges', []) if isinstance(G, dict) else [])

pipeline.objective: Read 'incident_graph_data.json' with read_file and generate 'incident_response_report.md' with write_file detailing Incident ID (#INC-8821), Initial Compromise Vector (DMZ_WEB_01), Shortest Attack Path, Total Path Exploitability Score, Impacted Nodes in Blast Radius, and Recommended Firewall Isolation Rule. Explicitly write out the report to 'incident_response_report.md' including node entity names.
